objective: Prove that the portable R139 image preserves the R137b row-invariant W8A16 kernel in production, retains R62's exact unchanged-FP16-target output and greater-than-54 tok/s single-user performance, and closes the 168-256-token endpoint repeat-determinism hole.
run_order: single-GPU production-image activation smoke with GEMM_KERNEL unset and DNNL_VERBOSE=all
only if activation passes, start the exact R119 two-B70 server configuration with a new empty compile cache
run the fixed 12-prompt natural-512 suite and independent canaries
compare every complete token array to the frozen explicit deterministic MTP0 oracle
on the same server, run five sequential repeats at prompt lengths 100, 168, 200, 224, 250, and 300 with full token-logprob comparison
graceful teardown and device health postflight

production_image_operator_gate.required_identity: M64, M128, and M168 outputs equal the corresponding prefixes of M200; M128 repeated and permuted outputs are exact; M168 equals the live-row prefix of an explicitly padded M200 call

medium_prefill_repeat_gate.required_at_every_length: one token-ID stream, one token-logprob array, one top-logprob array, and zero cached tokens

abort_conditions: production image selects any kernel other than the required fixed small/wide strategies or misses any operator identity assertion
any current-boot Xe fault, CAT error, reset, coredump, device loss, timeout, or hung stage visible to the available health interfaces
missing draft-only INT4 marker on either rank or any evidence that the FP16 target projection changed
any incomplete response, cached token, failed canary, or complete-array mismatch against the frozen oracle
on_pass: Promote R139 as the row-invariant single-user profile and preregister R141 with the frozen R63 c1-c64 serving configuration and token-identity matrix.
on_failure: Stop the server, preserve evidence, and do not proceed to concurrency or collective optimization.
